# `OpenApiConfiguratorResolver`

`Rasuvaeff\Mcp\OpenApi\OpenApiConfiguratorResolver`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Mcp\OpenApi`](/packages/mcp-openapi) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/mcp-openapi/blob/master/src/OpenApiConfiguratorResolver.php)

Turns the `openapi` params into the bridge, resolving application services
only when a configured feature needs them. Shared by the framework packages:
the keys are the same in each of them.

## Methods

### resolve()

```php
resolve(): ?OpenApiServerConfigurator
```

Null while the bridge is disabled: no spec or no operations.
